items.summary: Financial recommendation: approve containment and authorize no discretionary spend, new monetization investment, or forecast-based expansion this cycle. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. All $4.92 is an aggregate provider row under tracking ID other; site-attributed commission is $0. Do not report aggregate commission as site revenue. Contribution margin and ROI are not calculable because site-level revenue attribution, infrastructure costs, labor/change costs, and fixed costs are unavailable. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because no attributable financial outcome or comparable experiment result is available. AI spend is measurable only for 2026-10-01: 16 calls across 4 of 38 expected sites, costing $2.2785467; fleet-wide AI spend is unknown. Infrastructure and budget exposure are unknown because operations cost telemetry, monthly fixed costs, marketing budget, and spend limit are blank. Minimum measurement for the retained allthingsmasonic.com CTA request: use the 2026-09-21 baseline of 61 affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, 0 shipped items, and $0 site-attributed commission; after capacity clears, measure site-specific clicks, orders, shipped items, commission, direct change cost, allocated AI cost, and allocated infrastructure cost for 14 days or 100 relevant new impressions/clicks. If site-level financial data remains unavailable, classify contribution margin, ROI, payback, and causal lift as unknown. Preserve existing gates and do not create new finance telemetry requests because the available snapshot already establishes the current evidence boundary.
